[SWS_DM_01784] Service Validation of
SOVD
Requests
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04273
⌈
On reception of an SOVD request the DM shall call the according
ara::diag::
SovdServiceValidation::Validate
for each
DiagnosticSovdServiceVal-
idationPortMapping
configured in
DiagnosticServiceValidationConfigu-
ration
in the order configured. If any
ara::diag::SovdServiceValidation::
Validate
returns an error, then the DM shall immediately return an error to the client
and not proceed processing the request any further.
⌋
